name: convo_v5_agent_turn
description: v5: one chat turn run by the wealth_advisor Conductor Agent (AGENT task; v5.probe swaps in SIMPLE convo_v5_agent_run when the server has no AGENT support)

inputParameters.queryExpression:
(.prev.response.body? // .prev.workflow? // .prev) as $p
| (if ($p | type) == "object" then $p else {} end) as $w
| (if (.prevId // "") == "" then "fresh session: no previous execution id given"
   elif ($w.workflowId // "") == "" then "previous execution \(.prevId) was not found"
   elif $w.status != "COMPLETED" then "previous execution \(.prevId) is \($w.status), not COMPLETED"
   elif ($w.correlationId // "") != .sessionId and ($w.input.sessionId // "") != .sessionId
     then "previous execution \(.prevId) belongs to another session; starting fresh"
   else "" end) as $why
| (if $why == "" then ($w.output.history // [] | map(select(.role == "user" or .role == "assistant")) | .[-20:]) else [] end) as $h
| {restored: ($why == ""),
   memorySource: (if $why == "" then "explicit" else "none" end),
   memoryNote: (if $why == "" then "history restored from execution \(.prevId)" else $why end),
   history: $h,
   prompt: ((if ($h | length) > 0 then "Conversation so far:\n" + ($h | map("\(.role): \(.message)") | join("\n")) + "\n\n" else "" end) + "user: " + .message)}

(.agent.reply // .agent.result // .agent.output // "") as $r
| (if ($r | type) == "string" then $r else ($r | tostring) end) as $reply
| {reply: $reply,
   toolCalls: (.agent.toolCalls // []),
   agentMode: (.agent.agentMode // "server"),
   history: ((.history // []) + [{role: "user", message: .message}, {role: "assistant", message: $reply}] | .[-20:])}
